project.name: LaxmiEnterprise
project.description: Supervisor & Admin Attendance Tracking App with FastAPI backend and MongoDB database

nodes.name: usePerformanceMonitor.js
nodes.summary: Custom hook for performance profiling, render tracking, slow render logging, and async operation measurement

nodes.name: requestId.js
nodes.summary: Request ID generator and tracking utilities for end-to-end API tracing

nodes.name: logger.js
nodes.summary: Structured JSON logging utility with configurable log levels and security scrubbing

nodes.name: security.js
nodes.summary: Security validation, token sanitization, XSS defense, CSRF token generator, and RateLimiter class

nodes.name: config.js
nodes.summary: Centralized runtime configuration constants and environment management

nodes.name: QueryClient.jsx
nodes.summary: React Query client configuration with global auth error handling for Admin app

layers.name: Frontend User Interfaces
layers.description: React single-page applications for Supervisors and Admins built with Vite and Tailwind CSS.

layers.name: Backend API Services
layers.description: FastAPI REST API services for user authentication, session control, attendance management, and vehicle assignments.

layers.name: Database & Data Models
layers.description: MongoDB database access layer and Pydantic schemas for employees, vehicles, sessions, and attendance records.

layers.name: Shared Monorepo Packages
layers.description: Reusable React components, custom hooks, and API client utilities shared across application packages.

layers.name: Data Extractor Tools
layers.description: Python CLI and script extractor tools for parsing CS billing extracts and document data.

layers.name: Infrastructure & Configuration
layers.description: Docker Compose containers, environment configs, database seed scripts, and build workflows.
